reason: The restricted finite-table proof is proposal progress but does not identify the broader hidden-state target or provide useful precision for the small demonstration. A final R03S qualification study is not justified by this candidate.
unresolved_design_blockers: Hidden confounding admits observationally equivalent laws with different policy values; specify actual extra information or restrict the claim before a new study.

The finite-table proof requires sufficient finite histories, bounded reward, true support floors and independent complete customer trajectories. It does not supply continuous-history, arbitrary-learner or dependent-cohort estimation rates.
At T=2, n=1000, ce=.25, cg=.65 and B=2 the evaluation-only radius is 8.24269, larger than the entire eight-unit value range; total fitted-law radius is 9.61511.

The existing P4 law has Gaussian innovations and unbounded quadratic reward; changing to capped utility or finite states would be a new declared target/design, not reuse of this theorem for the old target.

Finite-value availability does not establish nonempty or decision-useful intervals. The original protocol has no bank width threshold; proposal utility screens must be declared prospectively rather than invented as bank criteria.
certification_screen_power: With 512 requests per cell, a one-sided simultaneous lower-bound screen at true coverage .95 is not likely to pass merely because nominal confidence is .95. No criterion is lowered or old draw reused. Current rejection occurs before empirical certification: identification/scope and width are already inadequate.
feasible_proposal_next_steps: Use the exact finite-state model as a separately labeled prototype comparison; fix action/retention fitting, training/evaluation roles, empty cells, policy class and useful utility width before final draws.
Derive and review a sharper variance-sensitive or sequential doubly robust interval with quantitative nuisance remainder control; retain hidden/censoring failures as negative controls.
For the unbounded P4 target supply tail/moment and continuous-model estimation arguments, or explicitly create a bounded utility variant and report the changed scientific target.
Study information acquisition and shorter horizons in public/generated scenarios; authentic bank evidence is conditional later work, not a blocker for the proposal.
revisit_trigger: A reviewed identified observation law, quantitative estimated-probability/dependence control, and a prospective useful-width/availability design must match the advertised target before final study registration.
